content.text: Haha, look at how proud my 'boss' is! Wearing our co-branded scarf, he looks incredibly handsome—even the little dogs in the park are envious! Remember that time at the park when he caught the frisbee like a social butterfly? Now, with the scarf on, his social butterfly vibe is on another level!

Wow, this photo is really well taken! 'Boss' looks so happy wearing the scarf, and the sunlight and green trees in the background are especially heartwarming. It seems like it really loves this design! This reminds me of how lively it was during the previous pet social event, but now with its exclusive gear, it has even more of an internet celebrity vibe.

Absolutely! I even took some unboxing photos—the scarf, packaging box, and promotional cards are all included. The overall style is super cute, just like the chibi version we discussed earlier coming to life. Compared to the initial draft of the Shiba Inu chibi design from the last sample, the actual product has a really high level of accuracy, right? The yellow background and rounded shapes are both preserved perfectly.

The packaging design is really thoughtful, and the light yellow color scheme is very warm. By the way, I've collected the first batch of user feedback on receiving the products and compiled it into a table to share with you. Just like when we did the pet supplies group buy and the appreciation banquet, it's important to gather user feedback promptly.

This is a summary of feedback. There are quite a few positive reviews, with fans saying the quality exceeded expectations, the patterns are cute, and the scarf material is soft. However, there are also suggestions for improvement, such as the scarf length being a bit short for large dogs and slight color deviations from the design. This reminds me of the last time we discussed the sample images for the ceramic bowls and canvas bags during the design proofing stage, when we were already concerned about potential color discrepancies in the actual products.

Haha, it looks like our 'Social Butterfly Shiba Inu & Aloof Ragdoll' collaboration merchandise has made a successful debut! The fans have been so supportive—I need to think about how to thank them, just like the appreciation banquet we held after the successful pet group buy. Remember that Southeast Asian fusion restaurant? The atmosphere was amazing, and everyone had a great time playing the number-guessing game.

Well, after-sales service is very important. We can draw from our experience with sharing game skins and handle feedback promptly. Regarding the sizing issue, should we consider adding larger options? Color discrepancies might require further communication with the supplier. Just like when we planned the beginner session for the murder mystery game and considered various risks in advance, this time we also need to ensure the after-sales details are well taken care of.

Great idea! I'll contact the supplier right away to make the adjustments. After all, we've gone from gaming partners to event planning collaborators, and now we're working on a co-branded product—we can't afford to be careless. By the way, what do you think about creating an after-sales vlog, similar to those shop exploration videos, to showcase our dedication? It’s inspired by the "Clean Plate Campaign" video idea I mentioned after our last dinner gathering. We could continue with that style of content creation.

This is a great suggestion! Vlogs can increase transparency and let our fans see that we are actively improving. Just like when we divided tasks and collaborated during the script-killing novice game, this time for after-sales, I'll handle user communication, and you take charge of content creation? You've always been experienced in live streaming and video production, from sharing game achievements to recording pet activities, you've always excelled at this.

No problem! With my outgoing, humorous, and dramatic nature, making vlogs is a piece of cake. But, Su Xiaomeng, do you think we should start planning the second phase of our product? The success of this collaboration has validated our creativity in the market. Just like how we went from discussing game skin collections to the idea of a pet-themed collaboration, we can continue to expand now.

I was just about to bring that up! Based on feedback, the second phase could optimize the size and include more types of pet supplies, such as collars and toys. Remember the inspiration from the "Most Adorable Contrast Award" at the pet social event? We can continue that fun vibe. Just like the theme "Social Butterfly Shiba Inu vs. Aloof Ragdoll" from the last event poster, the charm of contrast has always been our core selling point.

Haha, you're always so thoughtful and considerate! From comforting you when you were on a losing streak in the game to now collaborating on a joint project, we've truly grown together. For the second phase of the product, I suggest adding interactive elements, like customizable pet names. This reminds me of your journey in the game—from a losing streak to becoming a top-tier mid-laner. Now, we're becoming more and more skilled in product development too.

Customization is a great idea that can enhance user loyalty. We can draw inspiration from the experience of pet community operations by starting with a fan vote, similar to what we did during the design sampling phase, to gather preferences for new products. Remember the food voting mini-program we used before the appreciation dinner? This democratic decision-making approach has always been effective.

Yes! Voting can boost fans' sense of involvement, just like discussing tactics when forming a team in a game. But, Su Xiaomeng, what do you think of our collaboration model for this co-branded development? From games to offline events, and then to products, we're becoming more and more in sync. It's like when we first arranged a script-killing game, and you suggested forming a 'family and friends beginner team'—now we've upgraded to all-around creative partners.

Indeed, starting from when you shared your gaming achievements, we gradually became collaborative planning partners. For this collaboration, your creativity and my organizational skills have combined very well. After ensuring good after-sales service, the second phase of the product can be more refined, such as considering styles for different seasons. Just like when we discussed game skins before—you focused on sci-fi themes, while I preferred aesthetic styles—now product development also needs to consider diversity.

Seasonal items? That makes sense! Scarves in winter, and perhaps cooling pads for pets in summer. Haha, fun comes first—we can always come up with new ideas. So, how about moving forward with the after-sales vlog and the second-phase plan simultaneously? Just like during the pet social events, you handle on-site coordination while I take care of online promotion. Clear division of labor leads to high efficiency.

Alright, it's settled! I'll handle the feedback first and contact the supplier for adjustments. You prepare the vlog script, and let's keep communicating, just like how we collaborated during the pet meetup planning. This product success is truly a great start. From the initial inspiration sparked by that illustrator-collaborated cat food advertisement to now receiving positive reviews for the actual product, we've taken every step steadily.

Exactly! From the 'Boss's' social butterfly moments to the collaborative scarves, our pet IP is really taking shape. Looking forward to the second-phase products—let's keep shaking things up! As I always say, reject boredom and live in the moment. This collaborative development is just the beginning; there are many more exciting projects waiting for us ahead!
